description_expanded: OverviewHot TubInn at Seacrest - Community pool and 2 FREE bikes - `Nestled Inn`The Space Nestled Inn | Cozy Seacrest Beach Retreat QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected Steps to the community Pool – Relax & unwind just outside your door! Walking Distance to the Beach – No need for a car! Two FREE Bikes – Cruise 30A in style Prime Location – Close to dining, shopping & entertainment 1 Designated Parking Space – Hassle-free parking End Unit | Ground Floor – Easy access & added privacy Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service – Stress-free vacationingWelcome to Nestled InnThis adorable studio unit has everything you need for a relaxing vacation!It is the perfect getaway for two people who want privacy, yet close to all of the amazing activities that the area offers!This unit features a queen-sized bed, brand new flat screen TV, Kitchenette with microwave, fridge and a full bathroom!Our unit is an end unit on the ground floor. The coin operated washer and dryer also located on this level. The very private pool is right out your front door, the sugar white sand beach is a short stroll. Amazing restaurants and shops are within walking distance.Spend your vacation at "Nestled Inn" and you won't be disappointed!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (2):Studio: Queen sized bedAREA ATTRACTIONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.A lively community gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
